content.short: Cat Planets is a space exploration game on TON where players use cats to mine interplanetary resources.
content.description: Cat Planets is a charming and strategic space exploration game built on the TON blockchain. It invites players to command a fleet of adventurous cats as they travel across a virtual galaxy to mine valuable resources on different planets. Every planet and major resource is part of the game's decentralized economy, allowing players to earn and trade assets in a transparent environment. Cat Planets combines the popular 'cat' theme with deep exploration and resource management, providing a rewarding experience for fans of both genres within the TON network.
content.meta: Explore the stars with Cat Planets on TON. Interplanetary mining and cat-themed gaming on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
